items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: We would go in there and do a whole show with Velma Milton and the band.

ctx.x: We were going up in California, different spot where they had the soldiers. We weren't allowed to talk about where they were at -- you know, different place where they kept them.
But we would go in there and do a whole show with Velma Milton and the band. We do a whole hour and a half show for them.
